mapper.select: select m.* from sys_user_role as ur left join sys_role as r on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_role_menu as rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_menu as m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by m.order_num desc

select m.* from member_role as mr left join sys_role as r on r.role_id = mr.role_id left join sys_role_menu as rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_menu as m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where mr.member_id = #{memberId} order by m.order_num desc
